ownership_screen.distinction: Input ordinary-tag recursive compound/list/array merge plus unlocked/selected functional reader differs from fixed template replacement or nested composite/split, pending independent review.

whole_lifecycle_findings: Type registration, builder conversion and JSON/packet parser bind NBT_COPY to NBTCopyRecipe before populating output/options; unknown recipe_class uses DEFAULT identity converter. Declared bootstrap is not proof of runtime registration or deployment.

NBTCopyRecipe scans all altar inventory stacks against all search Ingredients. Every matching tagged stack adds a copied ordinary tag with no early break, so overlapping predicates may add it twice. It does not copy complete ItemStack.save/caps/count ownership.

Each output is a copied configured template; recursive merge then mutates output tags. Compounds recurse; same-tag-type lists equality-union, mismatched type replaces; int/long/byte arrays with true deduplicate values; scalar values overwrite from later input tags. No schema/clamp/ench-level-normalization or arbitrary key iteration guarantee.

Domic and ichosic upgrade builders are two parameters of one mechanism. Configured outputs unlock STARLIGHT plus AREA_SIZE or FLUID_FIELDS, select that mode; input upgrades union with output list, but input selected_upgrade scalar may overwrite desired output default. Functional ItemResonator reader clamps selection and requires unlocked mode plus progression, falling back to STARLIGHT when denied.

Inherited getOutputForRender returns first copied static template without input NBT scan. Constellation subclass runs same merged-output policy before optional constellation setter on compatible output items; render adds constellation only. This subclass/helpers/examples each add0.

Simple recipe gate checks initiating player progression, altar tier, optional constellation, starlight availability and Ingredient grid with no unrelated occupied extras.
